short_description: Kühne Holding AG is the Schindellegi-based Swiss investment holding vehicle of German-Swiss entrepreneur Klaus-Michael Kühne, holding his principal industrial and transport-sector investments — most prominently a majority position in the Kühne+Nagel logistics group and a substantial stake in the Hapag-Lloyd container-shipping line, alongside more recent minority positions in aviation and mobility, including a 35% co-investment (with EQT) in the German mobility operator Flix (FlixBus / FlixTrain) taken in July 2024.
